name: EglantinePS5
description: Experimental Nintendo Switch / Switch 2-capable Eglantine (Eden fork) emulator port for PS5. Requires your own legally obtained keys, firmware and games. This ZIP is an unofficial build published by the independent mucahidkambur fork; upstream heydemoura/EglantinePS5 has no GitHub release yet. Compatibility varies.
author: heydemoura / community fork build by mucahidkambur
